data.name: Playable vehicles
data.author: dr.RazdalByte
data.description:
Based on Rev:1.6-10
Changes vehicle fight tactics to who first sees - wins. Don't try to tank damage. Hide around corners, dig in, set ambushes, shot at long distances. 2 operators can focus fire entire convoy. Vehicles are fast on water and turrets can fight ships.
Suggestions on how to play: -If you're flying, don't do it low, slow, or both, it's dangerous for your well-being. -If you're driving, being out of cover, in open, alone, or both, is dangerous for your well-being. -2x30mm operators can outgun entire convoy from cover or corner. -Combats are lightning quick so spin the turret 360. -Fight two islands at a time, ground, air, or combine. -MULs are backbone for long range operations. -15mm turret is super accurate at 1000m+, 30mm mid ranges, 40mm mid-close -CIWS turret capable of fighting vehicles and ships -Vehicles repare and rearm faster -Gunbil RZR (autocannons) adjusted for fun close combat, RZR can take lots of hits -MNT is a glass gun, relies on speed and maneuverability -Droid turret on a seal is powerful and easy-to-man AA weapon, ciws is hard to handle manual, but capable of destroying bombs and missiles
